name: prodqc-agent
description: Effect-TS domain, multi-agent, transparency, insurance, and self-improvement abstractions for multi-modality bio-production & QC (protein, LNP, and future modalities)

scripts.deps:ext4: PROJECT_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/projects/$(basename "$PWD")-$(pwd -P | sha1sum | cut -c1-8)" && mkdir -p "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR" && cp package.json "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/package.json" && npm --prefix "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR" install --cache "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/npm" --no-audit --no-fund && ln -sfn "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/node_modules" node_modules
scripts.test: PROJECT_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/projects/$(basename "$PWD")-$(pwd -P | sha1sum | cut -c1-8)" && ln -sfn "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/node_modules" node_modules && node --preserve-symlinks "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc" --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions true --outDir "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/dist" && node --test "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/dist/tests/"*.test.js
scripts.demo:lnp: PROJECT_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/projects/$(basename "$PWD")-$(pwd -P | sha1sum | cut -c1-8)" && ln -sfn "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/node_modules" node_modules && node --preserve-symlinks "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc" --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions true --outDir "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/dist" && node "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/dist/src/demo/cli.js"
scripts.draft:protocol: PROJECT_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/projects/$(basename "$PWD")-$(pwd -P | sha1sum | cut -c1-8)" && ln -sfn "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/node_modules" node_modules && node --preserve-symlinks "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc" --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions true --outDir "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/dist" && node "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/dist/src/protocol-draft/cli.js"
scripts.draft:protocol:fixtures: PROTOCOL_DRAFT_MODEL=synthetic-fixture-v0 npm run draft:protocol -- --input fixtures/protocol-draft/versions --output output
